d: ''shri hanuman janmotsav ki hardik shubhkamnaen'' aaj ke is shubh din hanuman ji ke pyare pyare bhajnon ko sunen !!! sabse adhik pasand ki jane vali hanuman chalisa - harihran, mangal murti maruti nandan jay jay jay bajrangabli - hari Om sharan, hanuman amritvani - anuradha paudval, meri raksha karo bajrangabli - babla mehta, hanuman tumhara kya kahna - lakhbir sinh lakkha, teri jay jay jay hanuman - tripti shakya, hanuman ji hanuman ji - tripti shakya, jay balaji jay bajrangi - kumar vishu, tumhari jay ho vir hanuman - punam lakkha, Om jay hanumat vira hanuman ji ki aarti - anil bavra !!!
